summary: Iteration 10 — faithful-import verification of BDS Marvel. All 12 pytest cases pass and frontend contact form end-to-end submission returns 201. Scope: backend health, admin JWT login + /auth/me cookie session, auth gating on /api/inquiries and /api/admin/overview, inquiry/consultation/sample-request/product-inquiry POSTs with admin-list persistence verification, stays availability + stays booking creation, and frontend homepage + contact modal POST /api/inquiries.

issues: 4 console '401' errors from /api/auth/me probing on initial load — harmless but noisy (pre-existing, flagged in iteration 9 too)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1107 lines in a single file — consider splitting into routers (auth, inquiries, consultations, stays, admin) for maintainability, but this is a faithful import, so no change required now.

Public POST /api/inquiries, /api/consultations, /api/sample-requests, /api/product-inquiries are unauthenticated and have no rate limiting or captcha — spam risk; a basic rate limiter (slowapi) should be considered for production.

/api/auth/me returns 401 (expected) when no cookie present, but the frontend calls it on public pages (homepage, /contact) producing console noise; switch to a lighter session-probe or suppress 401 logging on probe.
Admin password is hard-coded in backend/.env (ADMIN_PASSWORD=<redacted>) and re-seeded on every startup — acceptable for dev but should be rotated for production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (home loads, nav renders, contact modal submits inquiry 201)

test_credentials: Admin: info@bdsmarvel.com / <redacted> (seeded on startup from backend/.env). Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Import is clean and working. Backend admin seeding, JWT cookie auth, all 4 public form POSTs (201 + persistence), stays availability + bookings, and FE contact modal flow all verified. Contact form lives in a modal opened via [data-testid="contact-get-in-touch"] on /contact — fields: contact-name-input, contact-email-input, contact-company-input, contact-message-input, submit: contact-modal-submit.
